title: Ultimate Puff Chilled Blue Raspberry Shortfill 0mg 100ml
description: Blue Raspberry is a flavour that never goes out of fashion and this exquisite eliquid from Ultimate Puff Chilled is perfect blend of tangy raspberry and sweet blueberries, all finished off with a bracing rush of cool menthol on the exhale. Blue Raspberry: perfected. These shortfill bottles contain 100ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 20ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill will give you 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the short fill bottle well.
